description: Compare three ways to give staff child care places, for one number of staff children under 5 in Texas or New York: reserved places at nearby providers, a shared center with other employers, and an on-site center. Each option shows first-year and later-year cost, the estimated federal Section 45F credit (40 percent of qualified spending, up to 500,000 USD a year; 50 percent and 600,000 USD for an eligible small business) and the cost after that estimate. Compares the modelled employer payment with the 2026 7,500 USD per employee dependent care limit. Pass worksiteZip or state, and annualPrices from real quotes when known. Educational estimate, not tax advice.

ageMix.description: Share of enrolled children by age group, such as {infant: 0.3, toddler: 0.3, preschool: 0.4} (default)

annualPrices.description: Full-time annual price per child in USD from real provider quotes; replaces the area defaults

children.description: Staff children under 5 the benefit should serve; use staff.likelyEnrolments.mid from scan_childcare_slots

employerShare.description: Share of tuition the employer pays, 0 to 1 (default one third)

smallBusiness.description: True only if the business says it meets the 45F small business test (average gross receipts of 32 million USD or less over the 5 prior years, related businesses counted together); raises the credit rate and cap

state.description: State when no ZIP is known

worksiteZip.description: Worksite ZIP in Texas or New York; sets the state price table

name: compare_care_options
title: Compare child care benefit options
